Source: TVB Pitztal

Description

The hike begins across from the fire station and follows the signs to the Stuiben Waterfall. The trail features two short, steeper ascents and leads to the base of the waterfall, where a viewing platform offers a spectacular view of this natural spectacle.

The route then descends to the hamlet of Schön. After crossing the Pitztal regional road, the trail continues through the hamlet of Schönlarch to the soccer field. Passing the Toyota Reinstadler dealership, the Pitztal regional road is crossed again. Passing through the Niederhof district, the route finally returns to the starting point, completing the loop hike.
